title: The Role of Graphs in the AI Space | Panel | Connected Data London 2024
description:
A panel of all-star graph and AI professionals in a discussion around AI, graph, how they play well, what to avoid, and everything in between.

Key Topics
Why is there so much conversation around AI and graphs?
How do we know graphs improve AI, who is measuring this, and how?
Where does Graph RAG fit in?
Pitfalls to watch out for
Advice on getting started in either graph or AI

Chief Data Officers
Data Scientists
Data Modelers
Technical Managers

Goals

Answer questions that matter
